data.body: 8705 PROOFS. (1) Pure move: diff of the extracted cluster against the original passes.py lines is EMPTY apart from two blank joiners and the 4-line function-local import block — zero body rewrites. (2) MUTATION PROOF (stronger than c6c9's): hoisting 'from .passes import PASS_COMPLETION, _max_output_cfg, _resolve_system' to module level does not merely defeat a monkeypatch — it is a HARD ImportError, 'cannot import name PASS_COMPLETION from partially initialized module rebar.llm.plan_review.passes (most likely due to a circular import)', and the whole plan_review package fails to import. passes.py imports completion_subcall at module level because register_contracts() runs at import time and needs _pass2_completion_model; at that point PASS_COMPLETION/_max_output_cfg/_resolve_system are not yet defined. Restored and re-verified. (3) Re-exports: all 9 moved names are the IDENTICAL object via passes.<name>; plan_review_completion contract still registers CompletionOutput. (4) ZERO test edits (git diff --stat -- tests/ is empty). (5) lint + typecheck green (mypy: 435 source files, no issues). (6) targeted suites 207 passed, incl. test_subcall_class_selection (its _UNFOLLOWABLE dict is path-keyed but does not name pass2_completion), test_module_size_contract, test_gate_context_seam. Sizes: passes.py 800 -> 595, completion_subcall.py 288.
